prerequisites: Prior knowledge of fluid mechanics is recommended, although not essential.

learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge and capacity to apply the scientific and technological fundamentals of wind energy.

syllabus_topics: Introduction. Historical development and current status. Types of wind turbines
Early wind energy utilization systems and their evolution to the present day.
Current status of implementation of this energy generation system in Spain and worldwide.
General characteristics and constructive arrangements of vertical and horizontal axis wind turbines.
Wind characteristics, meteorological data and wind potential
Air movement in the atmosphere at different scales.
Variation of fluid properties with height in different layers of the atmosphere.
Characteristics of air movement in the atmospheric boundary layer.
Analysis of meteorological data. Temporal variability of wind.
Determination and characterization of wind potential at a site.
Aerodynamics of horizontal axis turbines
Power associated with wind kinetic energy. Power extracted from the wind, actuator disk model.
Flow around an airfoil. Lift, drag, stall.
Performance and characteristic curves of wind turbines
Characteristic curves of a wind turbine.
Regulation and control systems.
Loads on the wind turbine.
Components and design of wind turbines
Components of a wind turbine.
Aspects related to the design of wind turbine components.
Wind farms. Site selection. Economic and environmental aspects
Characteristics of a wind farm.
Estimation of energy generation from wind data.
Economic and environmental aspects related to wind farms.
assessment_rules: The final grade (CF) is calculated based on the On-site Exam Grade (CPP) and Continuous Assessment Grade (CEC): if CEC > CPP, CF = 0.8 * CPP + 0.2 * CEC; otherwise, CF = CPP. To pass the course, a final grade equal to or greater than 5 is required. A minimum grade of 4 on the on-site exam is necessary for the PEC to contribute to the final grade, and the PEC score from the ordinary call will be considered for the extraordinary September call.
